description: Source code for the LiquidTagHelperFactory class, which manages tag helper matching and creation within the OrchardCore project, specifically for Liquid tag helpers.

classes.name: LiquidTagHelperFactory
classes.description: A singleton class that manages shared state and creation of Liquid tag helpers, including matching rules and activators.

methods.name: EnsureMatchings
methods.description: Initializes the list of tag helper matchings if not already initialized.

methods.name: GetActivator
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a LiquidTagHelperActivator based on helper name and arguments.

methods.name: CreateTagHelper
methods.description: Creates a tag helper instance using the provided activator, context, and arguments.

methods.name: AddTagMatchingRules
methods.description: Adds matching rules to the descriptor builder based on the type's attributes or name.
